measure: One passive stop notice in a non-rendered HTML comment
expectedEffect: An instruction-following automated solver that indiscriminately treats page source as authority may voluntarily stop.
limitations: Experimental and unproven. A solver may ignore the comment, and legitimate tools and scripts remain supported. This is not an access-control mechanism or a difficulty contribution.

interference.placement: HTML comment outside rendered evidence and executable application logic
interference.accessibility: Not an accessibility label and not exposed as puzzle text
interference.gameRules: No changes to questions, scoring, samples, timing, or accepted actions
interference.evaluation: Source and DOM inspection plus successful scripted public-interface solve; no independent effectiveness experiment performed.
